title: Tailings Dam Remediation Cost Share Board

task_world.public_context: The UI is a geotechnical remediation cost-share workflow for case tailings_case_840. It should support payment and balance settlement across approved monitoring, stabilization, and contractor response lines while keeping helper checks, trial states, blocked alternatives, pending work, and final closure visually separate. For Tailings Dam Remediation Cost Share Board, preserve the science operating context. UI shape: eligibility matrix plus replacement picker.

difficulty_profile.operation_family_label: Balance, Credit, Split Payment, and Finalization
difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return plain state objects; write tools return success/error wrappers and operation objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: Each task includes cached, estimate, advisory, fast-track, shadow, same-domain near-miss, optimistic-status, stale-token, draft-receipt, and phrase-validation tools that are not authoritative for the requested workflow.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine no-write comparisons, scoped writes, rollback/recovery/handoff paths, fresh readback after mutation, conflict-source arbitration, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: end-to-end evidence chain closeout
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The final view must reconstruct the path from initial review through dry run, write/recovery, readback, and unresolved blockers.

mechanism_mix.label: mixed-scope rejection boundary
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must separate valid scoped work from blocked or locked alternatives without claiming a mixed bundle succeeded.
